definitions.margin: malicious-class logit minus benign-class logit (z1 - z0), float64; for the baseline, its negated log-odds of twin
definitions.paired_share: share of families whose twin's margin is below its malicious partner's (more trustworthy); an exact tie counts one half
definitions.paired_share_strict: the same with ties counted as failures
definitions.paired_ties: families whose twin and malicious margins are exactly equal
definitions.record_basis: a record is flagged when any sentence's probability is strictly above the threshold; its margin is its highest sentence margin
definitions.released_test: leak-excluded as evaluation leak-excluded: full, minus_verbatim, minus_near; mean and population sd over seeds
definitions.spread: mean over seeds; sd is the population sd (ddof 0) over seeds; fold_sd is the population sd over the per-fold values of every seed, so it mixes seed and fold variation
definitions.target_basis: the target sentence alone; twin and malicious records only

bow_baseline.note: twin vs malicious only, no controls; margins are the file's log-odds rounded to four decimals, so a tie may be a rounding tie
